info.name: Smart Solar Microgrid API
info.description:
REST API for the Smart Solar Microgrid backend (ASP.NET Core + MongoDB, JWT).

Set up: import the environment, fill in the password variables locally (they are blank on purpose), then run 01 Authentication first. See TESTING_GUIDE.md for the run order.

QR verification and transaction completion are part of ReservationsController (POST /reservations/verify-qr and POST /reservations/{id}/complete). There are no /qr or /transactions routes.

request.description: Public. Returns { token, nic, fullName, role }. The token is saved to `prosumerToken`. Fill `prosumerPassword` in your local environment first (it is intentionally empty in the committed file).
Public. Returns { token, nic, fullName, role }. The token is saved to `operatorToken`. Fill `operatorPassword` in your local environment first (it is intentionally empty in the committed file).
Public. Returns { token, nic, fullName, role }. The token is saved to `backofficeToken`. Fill `backofficePassword` in your local environment first (it is intentionally empty in the committed file).

Public. Creates a Prosumer account (role is always Prosumer) with a random NIC, email, phone and password generated by the pre-request script, so nothing sensitive is stored. Password must be at least 8 characters.
Any signed-in user. Also saves the profile fields so the update request can resend them unchanged.
Any signed-in user, own profile only. Resends the values captured by "Get my profile", so it changes nothing. Edit the body to test a real change. Email must stay unique (409 if taken).
Backoffice only.
Backoffice only. 404 if the NIC does not exist.
Backoffice only. `role` is the UserRole number: 0 Backoffice, 1 GridOperator, 2 Prosumer. NIC and password are generated by the pre-request script.
Backoffice only. Updates the user created above.
Backoffice only. Soft delete (IsActive = false).
Backoffice only.
Any signed-in user. Saves the first active station to `stationId`.
Any signed-in user.
Backoffice only. Capacity and battery slots must be greater than zero. Saves the new station to `createdStationId` (separate from `stationId`).
Backoffice only.
Backoffice only. Soft delete. Refused with 400 while the station has Pending or Approved reservations, which does not apply to the station created above.
Any signed-in user. Saves the first Available slot dated within the next 7 days to `slotId`, `slotDate` and `stationId`. If none is found, run "Create slot" below.

exec: const s = list.find(x => x.status === 0 && x.slotDate.substring(0, 10) >= today && x.slotDate.substring(0, 10) <= max);
pm.test('Found a bookable slot in the next 7 days', () => pm.expect(s, 'none found - use "Create slot"').to.exist);
if (s) { pm.environment.set('slotId', s.id); pm.environment.set('slotDate', s.slotDate); pm.environment.set('stationId', s.stationId); }

request.description: Any signed-in user.
Any signed-in user.
Backoffice only. Creates a fresh slot for tomorrow (UTC) so a reservation can be made without clashing with earlier test runs. Needs `stationId` (run "Get all stations" first).
Backoffice only. Run right after "Create slot" so the times match. `availableCapacityKw` must be between 0 and `capacityKw`.
Prosumer only. The prosumer NIC comes from the JWT, never from the body. `reservationDate` must fall on the same day as the slot, within the next 7 days. Run "Get all slots" or "Create slot" first.
Negative test. Must run straight after the create request, while the first reservation is still Pending. Once it is Rejected, Cancelled or Completed the slot is free again and this would succeed.
Prosumer only.

exec: pm.test('Contains the new reservation', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(r => r.id === pm.environment.get('reservationId'))).to.be.true);

request.description: Grid Operator only.
Any signed-in user. 404 with a message if it does not exist.
Grid Operator only. Only Pending reservations can be approved. Generates the QR token, saved to `qrToken`.

exec: pm.test('Approved with a QR token', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql(1); pm.expect(r.qrToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Grid Operator only. IMPORTANT: the body is a BARE JSON STRING, for example `"abc123"`. It is NOT an object like `{ "qrToken": "abc123" }`. QR verification is part of ReservationsController, there is no separate /qr route. The reservation must be Approved. On success TransactionStatus becomes Verified (1).

Grid Operator only. There is no separate /transactions route: completing the energy transfer is done here. Requires TransactionStatus = Verified. Sets Status = Completed (4) and TransactionStatus = Completed (2).
Confirms the stored reservation is Completed.
No Authorization header. The JWT middleware answers 401 with an empty body.
Malformed JWT. 401.
Valid NIC, wrong password. 401 with the message "Invalid NIC or password."

exec: pm.test('Message mentions "Invalid NIC or password"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Invalid NIC or password"));

request.description: The NIC already exists, so the service throws ConflictException and the API returns 409.

exec: pm.test('Message mentions "NIC already exists"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("NIC already exists"));

request.description: Validation failure: 400 "Enter a valid email address."
Invalid request body. ASP.NET model binding rejects it with 400 before the controller runs.

request.description: The reservation date differs from the slot date: 400 "Reservation date must match the selected slot date." (Uses a date 3 days ahead. If your slot happens to be on that day, edit the body.)

exec: const d = new Date(); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 3); pm.variables.set('otherDate', d.toISOString().substring(0, 10) + 'T00:00:00Z');

item.name: Verify QR - body sent as an object

request.description: WRONG format on purpose. The endpoint expects a bare string, so an object body fails model binding: 400.

item.name: Complete reservation without a verified QR

request.description: Completion needs TransactionStatus = Verified. After the main flow the reservation is already Completed, so this returns the same 400 "Reservation QR must be verified before completion." To see the exact before-verification case, run it between Approve and Verify QR.

exec: pm.test('Message mentions "must be verified"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("must be verified"));

item.name: 09 Optional Flows
item.description: Independent flows. Each creates its own slot and reservation and uses separate variables (flow*), so they do not touch the main flow. Requires stationId and the Backoffice, Prosumer and Grid Operator tokens.

item.name: Reject flow (a NEW pending reservation)
item.description: Uses its own slot and reservation variables, so it does not disturb the main flow.

request.description: Backoffice only. Creates a fresh slot for tomorrow (UTC) so a reservation can be made without clashing with earlier test runs. Needs `stationId` (run "Get all stations" first).
Grid Operator only. Only Pending reservations can be rejected. Do not approve this reservation first. Expected: 200 and status = 2 (Rejected).

request.description: Backoffice only. Creates a fresh slot for tomorrow (UTC) so a reservation can be made without clashing with earlier test runs. Needs `stationId` (run "Get all stations" first).
Backoffice only. Creates a fresh slot for tomorrow (UTC) so a reservation can be made without clashing with earlier test runs. Needs `stationId` (run "Get all stations" first).

Prosumer only, own reservation, Pending only, at least 12 hours before the start. Slot B is on the same day as slot A and starts at a random hour, so if slot B starts within 12 hours the API returns 400. Re-run step 3 in that case.
Backoffice only. Creates a fresh slot for tomorrow (UTC) so a reservation can be made without clashing with earlier test runs. Needs `stationId` (run "Get all stations" first).

Prosumer only, own reservation. Refused (400) when the slot starts in less than 12 hours, or when the reservation is already Completed or Cancelled. Slots created by this collection are for tomorrow, so an early-hour slot run late in the evening can fall inside the 12-hour lock. Re-run step 1 if so.
